# rixl_video_stats (Data Source)

Fetches aggregate viewing statistics, playback sessions, watch time, and completion rates for a video.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_video_stats" "intro" {
  video_id = var.rixl_video_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `video_id` (String)

### Optional

- `rangeend` (String) The range.end query parameter.
- `rangestart` (String) The range.start query parameter.

### Read-Only

- `avg_watch_time_ms` (Number)
- `completion_rate` (Number)
- `completions` (String)
- `starts` (String)
- `total_views` (String)
- `total_watch_time_ms` (Number)
- `unique_viewers` (String)
- `watches` (String)
